en: A colored historical postcard showing an allegorical female figure in a purple dress and laurel wreath holding a large Greek flag. She stands on a red map-like shape that appears to depict territory with Ottoman symbols. In the background is a lake or wide river with small steamships and low hills, suggesting a town on the far bank. Greek text appears at the bottom left and a numerical code at the bottom right, with a watermark-like logo and the URL 'www.elia.org.gr' overprinted.
